# Browse files and folders
<!-- generated by docs:update_by_ai -->
<!-- page type: how-to -->

Find a file or folder in the repository of the selected workspace.

## Browse the folder tree
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->

1. Select the workspace whose repository you want to browse.
2. Click the folder icon at the top of the sidebar icon bar of the left sidebar, above the Scripts icon, to show the **Files** sidebar section.
3. Click a folded folder to unfold the folder.
4. Continue unfolding folders until the file or folder row you need is visible.

To view a file, follow [Open a file](/documentation/open_a_file).

## Refresh the folder tree
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->

After files change outside Heidrun:

1. Click **Refresh**, the circular arrow in the header of the Files sidebar section.
2. Check the folder tree for the changed files or folders.

## Collapse all folders
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->

1. Click **Collapse all folders**, the minus sign in a square in the header of the Files sidebar section.

Every unfolded folder folds. The folder tree shows only rows at the repository root.

## Troubleshooting
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/i18n/locales/en/filesPanel.json -->

### “Select a workspace.” appears

**Cause**: No workspace is selected.

**Solution**:

1. Select a workspace that is a Git repository.

**Check**: The Files sidebar section shows the folder tree.

### “This workspace is not a Git repository.” appears

**Cause**: The selected workspace is not a Git repository.

**Solution**:

1. Select a workspace that is a Git repository.

**Check**: The Files sidebar section shows the folder tree of the selected repository.

### **Refresh** is disabled

**Cause**: Heidrun is loading the folder tree.

**Solution**:

1. Wait for loading to finish.

**Check**: **Refresh** becomes available again.

### “The list is too long: only the first files are shown.” appears

**Cause**: The repository has more files than the folder tree can display.

The folder tree is incomplete. The Files sidebar section has no control to reveal the omitted files.

## Related pages

- [Open a file](/documentation/open_a_file): to view a file you found.
- [Create a file or folder](/documentation/create_a_file_or_folder): to add an empty file or folder.
- [Files sidebar section](/documentation/files_sidebar_reference): to look up controls and limits.

# Change the Files list appearance
<!-- generated by docs:update_by_ai -->
<!-- page type: how-to -->

Adjust spacing and the lines that show folder levels in the Files sidebar section.

## Change the list appearance
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/SourceControlMenu.vue -->

1. Click the folder icon at the top of the sidebar icon bar of the left sidebar to show the **Files** sidebar section for the selected workspace.
2. Click **More options**, the three vertical dots in the header of the Files sidebar section.
3. Under **Indentation**, choose **Small**, **Medium**, or **Large** to set how far each folder level shifts to the right.
4. Reopen **More options**.
5. Under **Row height**, choose **Compact** for less vertical space or **Comfortable** for more vertical space.
6. Reopen **More options**.
7. Under **Indent guides**, choose **Show** to display lines that show folder levels or **Hide** to remove those lines.

Each choice closes the menu. Change only the choices you need.

## Check the selected choices
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->

The folder tree changes immediately after each choice, and Heidrun saves the choices.

1. Reopen **More options**.
2. Check the check mark beside the selected choice in each group.

## Related pages

- [Browse files and folders](/documentation/browse_files): to find files with the chosen appearance.
- [Files sidebar section](/documentation/files_sidebar_reference): to compare the appearance choices.

# Copy a file path
<!-- generated by docs:update_by_ai -->
<!-- page type: how-to -->

Copy a file location to paste into a terminal or another application.

## Copy a file path
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->

An absolute path is the full location of a file on your computer. A relative path gives the location starting from the workspace folder.

1. [Browse files and folders](/documentation/browse_files) to find the file row in the Files sidebar section.
2. Right-click the file row to open a context menu, a small menu beside the pointer.
3. Choose **Copy absolute path** for the full location, or **Copy relative path** for the location from the workspace folder.

The menu closes, and a message shows the copied path.

4. Paste the path where you need the file location.

## Troubleshooting
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->

### The path-copy menu does not appear

**Cause**: Folder rows have no path-copy context menu.

**Solution**:

1. Right-click a file row instead of a folder row.
2. Choose **Copy absolute path** or **Copy relative path**.

**Check**: A message shows the copied file path.

## Related pages

- [Browse files and folders](/documentation/browse_files): to find the file whose path you need.
- [Open a file](/documentation/open_a_file): to view the file before using the path.
- [Files sidebar section](/documentation/files_sidebar_reference): to look up the two path choices.

# Create a file or folder
<!-- generated by docs:update_by_ai -->
<!-- page type: how-to -->

Create an empty file or folder in the repository folder you choose.

## Choose the destination
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->

1. [Browse files and folders](/documentation/browse_files) in the workspace where you want to create the file or folder.
2. Choose the destination with one of these actions:
   - Click a folder row to create the file or folder inside that folder.
   - Click a file row to use the folder containing that file; the file also opens in the large Git window, which you can close with **Escape**.
   - Click empty space outside every row in the Files sidebar section to use the repository root, the top folder of the repository.

## Create the file or folder
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->

1. Click **New file**, the file icon with a plus sign, or **New folder**, the folder icon with a plus sign, in the header of the Files sidebar section.

A name box appears beneath the destination folder, before the other children of that folder. For the repository root, the name box appears at the top of the folder tree.

2. Type only the new name in the name box, without `/`.
3. Press **Enter**.

The new file or folder appears as the selected row. A new file also opens in the large Git window.

## Cancel creation
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->

1. Press **Escape** while the name box has focus, or click outside the name box.

The name box closes without creating a file or folder.

## Troubleshooting
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/i18n/locales/en/filesPanel.json -->

### The name box stays open after **Enter**

**Cause**: The name contains `/` or a file or folder with that name already exists in the destination folder.

**Solution**:

1. Replace the name with a name that has no `/` and does not already exist in the destination folder.
2. Press **Enter**.

**Check**: The name box closes, and the new row appears selected.

### A newly created empty folder no longer appears after restarting Heidrun

**Cause**: Git does not list empty folders, and Heidrun shows newly created empty folders only until Heidrun restarts.

Restarting Heidrun does not delete the folder. **Refresh** does not restore the row of a folder that is still empty after a restart.

## Related pages

- [Browse files and folders](/documentation/browse_files): to find the destination folder.
- [Open a file](/documentation/open_a_file): to view a file from the folder tree.
- [Files sidebar section](/documentation/files_sidebar_reference): to look up creation controls and limits.

# Files sidebar section
<!-- generated by docs:update_by_ai -->
<!-- page type: reference -->

Look up the controls, row meanings, and limits of the Files sidebar section.

## Folder tree
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->

The Files sidebar section shows the folder tree of the Git repository of the selected workspace. The folder icon at the top of the sidebar icon bar of the left sidebar, above the Scripts icon, represents the Files sidebar section.

The folder tree includes files tracked by Git and new files that Git does not yet track. Folders come before files, with alphabetical ordering within each group. Ignored folders appear only when the option to show ignored files is enabled; ignored folders cannot unfold.

## Header buttons
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->

The header stays visible while the rows scroll. The five buttons appear in this order from left to right.

| Button | Icon | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **New file** | File with a plus sign | Shows a name box for an empty file in the selected folder, the folder of the selected file, or the repository root when nothing is selected. |
| **New folder** | Folder with a plus sign | Shows a name box for an empty folder in the same destination choices as **New file**. |
| **Refresh** | Circular arrow | Reloads the folder tree; disabled during loading. |
| **Collapse all folders** | Minus sign in a square | Folds every folder. There is no button to unfold every folder. |
| **More options** | Three vertical dots | Opens the list appearance choices. |

## More options
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->

A check mark identifies the selected choice in each group. Heidrun saves the choices.

| Group | Choices and meanings |
| --- | --- |
| **Indentation** | **Small**, **Medium**, **Large**: increasing amounts of space to the left for each folder level. |
| **Row height** | **Compact**: less vertical space; **Comfortable**: more vertical space. |
| **Indent guides** | **Show**: lines that show folder levels; **Hide**: no lines. |

## Rows and selection
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/desktop_tauri/src/files.rs -->

| Row detail | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Right-pointing folder arrow | The folder is folded. |
| Downward-pointing folder arrow | The folder is unfolded. |
| File icon | Indicates the kind of file; file rows have no folder arrow. |
| Status letter at the right | **M**: modified; **A**: added; **D**: deleted; **R**: renamed; **U**: new file not tracked by Git. |
| Dot at the right of a folder row | The folder contains changes. |
| Selected-row background and outline | Marks the one selected row with a darker background and a visible outline. |

## Selection and folder state
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->

Each workspace has its own selected row. Selection remains when another sidebar section is shown or the large Git window closes. Returning to a workspace reveals the selected row with the folders above the selected row unfolded.

Folder folds remain when another sidebar section is shown. Empty space outside every row clears selection only in the selected workspace.

## File context menu
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->

The context menu is a small menu at the pointer, available only on file rows. The items appear in this order, and a message shows the copied text after a copy.

| Item | Copied location |
| --- | --- |
| **Copy absolute path** | The full location of the file on the computer. |
| **Copy relative path** | The location of the file from the workspace folder. |

**Escape**, a click outside the context menu, or choosing an item closes the context menu.

## Availability and limits
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/i18n/locales/en/filesPanel.json -->

| Message or limit | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| “Select a workspace.” | No workspace is selected. |
| “This workspace is not a Git repository.” | The selected workspace has no Git repository to show. |
| **Refresh** disabled | The folder tree is loading. |
| “The list is too long: only the first files are shown.” | Only part of the repository's file list is displayed. |
| Ignored folder cannot unfold | An ignored folder is shown as one row without its contents. |
| Newly created empty folder | The row remains visible until Heidrun restarts; Git does not list empty folders. A restart does not delete the folder. |
| Available file changes | The Files sidebar section can create an empty file or folder, and has no rename, move, delete, or edit controls. |

## Related pages

- [Browse files and folders](/documentation/browse_files): to find, refresh, or collapse the folder tree.
- [Create a file or folder](/documentation/create_a_file_or_folder): to choose a destination and enter a name.
- [Copy a file path](/documentation/copy_a_file_path): to copy a file location elsewhere.
- [Change the Files list appearance](/documentation/change_the_files_list_appearance): to adjust spacing and folder-level lines.

# Open a file
<!-- generated by docs:update_by_ai -->
<!-- page type: how-to -->

View a repository file in the large Git window from the Files sidebar section.

## Open a file from the Files sidebar section
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/GitModal.vue -->

1. [Browse files and folders](/documentation/browse_files) to find the file row in the Files sidebar section.
2. Click the file row.

The large Git window opens with the selected file. A file with no changes appears as a whole file.

3. Press **Escape** when you have finished viewing the file.

The large Git window closes, and the file row stays selected in the Files sidebar section.

## Troubleshooting
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/GitModal.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/i18n/locales/en/gitModal.json -->

### **Diff** and **Side by side** are disabled

**Cause**: The selected file has no changes to compare.

**Solution**:

1. Click **File** near the top of the large Git window to view the whole file.

**Check**: The large Git window shows the file contents instead of a comparison.

## Related pages

- [Browse files and folders](/documentation/browse_files): to find another file.
- [Copy a file path](/documentation/copy_a_file_path): to use the file location elsewhere.
- [Files sidebar section](/documentation/files_sidebar_reference): to look up file rows and selection.
